title: Package Marked Delivered but Customer Didn't Receive It
agent_context: Package is marked delivered but customer can’t find it. Apologize, verify delivery details and safe-drop options, open a carrier investigation immediately, and set a concrete update timeline plus when refund/replacement becomes available.

raw_content.initial_message: Tracking says ‘Delivered’ but there’s NOTHING here. I’ve checked everywhere. So where is my package?
raw_content.context: Shipment marked delivered but customer claims not received. Policy: apologize, verify address and delivery details, check safe drop/neighbor/front desk, open carrier investigation, set timeline for resolution, and explain replacement/refund options after investigation window.

learning_objectives: Collect the right delivery details quickly
Set clear expectations and resolution timeline
correct_sop_steps: Verify order ID and delivery address safely
Confirm delivery timestamp and any proof-of-delivery
Open carrier investigation and set update timeline
Explain replacement/refund policy after investigation window

sticky_notes: KEY: Immediate action + timeline matters most.
TRAP: Never imply the customer is lying.
HINT: Commit to a specific update time.

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will calm down if investigation is opened immediately with a clear update timeline
